name: Love Love Relations
source:
It's not just new dating. It's also being by your side at accidental times.
There's also that sort of "love".

You are Tomonaka, the single son of the Kazamidori Cafe.
Each day you're working hard to succeed your parents, creating beautiful-tasting coffee and tea.
One of the shop regulars is an older childhood friend who loves the big size.
She tastes Tomonaka's concoctions every day, and those days never change.

But one day, two girls (class chairman and student president) ask for help with the school festival.

The air is rich with excitement on campus. On these life-altering festival days, a new story begins.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ062595.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这不仅仅是新的约会。也在不经意的时候陪伴在你身边。
还有这样的“爱”。

你是风绿咖啡馆的独生子友中。
每一天，你都在努力工作，以继承父母的事业，制作美味的咖啡和茶。
店里的常客之一是一位年长的儿时朋友，喜欢大尺寸。
她每天都会品尝友中的调酒，那些日子永远不会改变。

但有一天，两个女孩（班长和学生会长）在学园祭上寻求帮助。

校园里的空气充满了兴奋。在这些改变生活的节日里，一个新的故事开始了。
